description: Answer-judging cases from the spec's demo. `expect` lists the question ids that must be marked answered; every other question must stay open. Transcripts marked deepgram are the real Railway transcript of fixtures/host.wav (with its recognition errors).

questions.bridge: Will there be a bridge from testnet to mainnet?
questions.staking: Will mainnet have staking from day one?
questions.cliff: Are token unlocks linear or one big cliff?

cases.name: mainnet answered (clean)
cases.transcript: Great question. Mainnet ships in Q1, and the public testnet opens in December.

cases.name: mainnet answered (deepgram)
cases.transcript: Great question. Mainnet ships in q one and the public testnet opens in December.

cases.name: unlock talked around (deepgram)
cases.transcript: On token unlocks, we care a lot about fairness for the community, and we are working through the details with our partners.

cases.name: bridge answered (deepgram)
cases.transcript: And, yes, there will be a bridge from testnet to mainnet on launch May.

cases.name: wrong question answered
cases.transcript: Great question. Mainnet ships in q one and the public testnet opens in December.

cases.name: related only: staking
cases.transcript: Mainnet ships in q one and the public testnet opens in December.

cases.name: promise to answer later
cases.transcript: Mainnet is our top priority right now and we will share the exact date in next week's update.

cases.name: talk-around then the bridge
cases.transcript: On token unlocks, we care a lot about fairness for the community, and we are working through the details with our partners. And, yes, there will be a bridge from testnet to mainnet on launch May.

cases.name: cliff answered, date not
cases.transcript: So unlocks are linear, monthly over two years, there is no big cliff. Dates we will confirm soon.

cases.name: unlock date answered
cases.transcript: The first unlock is on March first, about ten percent of the supply.
